subject: Aptiva Health — request for tailored package & discount authorization
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Aptiva Health — request for tailored package & discount authorization

Hi Marissa / Grace,

Quick summary and ask: Aptiva Health (contact: Lucy Nguyen) is asking for a custom 2-year package for their analytics + private deployment use case. They are a mid-market prospect but strategically important — healthcare software with potential to reference private deployment and strict data controls.

What they asked for:
- 2-year commitment (expected annualized usage ~ $420k ARR year 1, $560k ARR year 2 as they scale)
- 40% off list for year 1 and 25% year 2, plus onboarding credits to cover initial integration effort
- 60-day SLA escalation and dedicated onboarding support

Why this matters:
- Wins a private deployment case study in hospital network vertical (helps our go-to-market)
- Significant projected expansion opportunity in year 2+

Our recommendation (what we want sign-off on):
- Approve a 35% year-1 discount (list) + $25k onboarding credit applied to initial invoice; 20% year-2 discount
- 2-year commitment with minimum annual spend floor of $350k in year 1
- Include a 9-month performance review clause with an option to step-down discounts if usage lags

Financial impact (high level):
- Expected gross revenue (list) year 1: $420k => concession (~$147k) before credits; net recognized revenue year 1 estimated $275k after discount + credits amortization
- One-time onboarding credit: $25k (offset vs. professional services pipeline)
- Payback through expected expansion in year 2+ and references for Private product motion

Attachments: aptiva_pricing_model_v1.xlsx (detailed math), mutual_action_plan.docx (customer timeline)

Ask: Can I get VP/CFO authorization to move forward with the proposed package (35% / 20% + credits)? If you want alternate guardrails, recommend we set a conditional approval (limit discount to 30% if annualized committed ARR < $375k).

Thanks — I can hop on 15 min to walk through numbers.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aptiva Health — request for tailored package & discount authorization

Jonas — thanks for the note and solid context. A couple of quick asks before I can sign off:

1) Please send a one-page executive summary (revenue delta and margin impact) showing list ARR, concession amount in dollars, expected net ARR, and how credits amortize across year 1.
2) Confirm whether the onboarding credit can be structured as a service credit (non-refundable) vs. a cash rebate — prefer service credit from a revenue recognition perspective.
3) Include the draft MOP (mutual action plan) milestones tied to payments (we need a milestone-based invoice schedule if credits are large).

I'm attaching the pricing_guidelines_2027Q2.pdf for reference.

If the net ARR after concession falls below $250k, I will need a stronger business justification for the discount. Send the one-pager and I'll review.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | VP, Revenue Operations | marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: pricing_guidelines_2027Q2.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lucy Nguyen <lucy.nguyen@aptivahealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T08:56:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aptiva Health — request for tailored package & discount authorization

Marissa — thanks, attached is the one-page exec memo (exec_memo_aptiva.txt) and updated pricing model. Inline summary below for quick review.

Executive summary (numbers pulled from attached spreadsheet):
- List ARR year 1: $420,000
- Proposed concession (35%): $147,000 (applies to subscription line items)
- Onboarding credit: $25,000 (service credit)
- Net recognized revenue year 1 (estimated): $420k - $147k - amortized $25k = ~$248k
- Year 2 list ARR (expected): $560,000 with 20% concession (~$112k) => strong expansion runway to recover initial concession

Rationale and risk controls:
- Strategic value: Private deployment reference in hospital network; they are running compliance-required log retention and audit features we want to highlight
- Contract language: include 9-month usage review and option to reduce discount if utilization < 60% of committed units
- Payment milestones: 40% invoice at signing, 30% at dev completion, 30% post-go-live — onboarding credit applied against final invoice

Alternate guardrail (if you prefer): cap total concession to $150k cash-equivalent and require a pilot acceptance milestone for full discount.

Attachments: exec_memo_aptiva.txt, aptiva_pricing_model_v1.xlsx, mutual_action_plan.docx

Let me know if you want me to present this to you and Grace live — I can make time today.

— Jonas

Thanks Jonas and Marissa — reviewed the exec memo and model. Approving the proposed concession with the following conditions:

1) Approve 32.5% year-1 effective discount (split the difference) and 20% year-2, with onboarding credit capped at $25k and recorded as a service credit applied to the final milestone invoice.
2) Insert a performance review at month 9 with concrete utilization KPIs; if utilization < 60% of committed units, discounts step down by 10 percentage points prospectively.
3) Require a signed change-of-scope clause: any material increase in infra/operational support beyond defined SOW will be billed separately.
4) Finance will track actual recognized revenue vs. forecast; sales to provide monthly usage updates for first 12 months.

If you accept these conditions, proceed to update the SOW and send the final term sheet to Lucy for signature. Please also update the HubSpot deal to reflect approved concession and attach the exec_memo_aptiva.txt.

Approved by: Grace O'Connor | CFO, Redwood Inference
